subject: Regarding Error faced in extracting the CSV data.

messages.author: 3e9c37b65dfe9196
messages.subject: Regarding Error faced in extracting the CSV data.
parts:
Hello sir,
Greetings to you sir.
Sir i used the following codes to extract the CSV data but i faced the error stated below, It's a request to please help me out regarding the same sir. 

The code used:

library(FIELDimageR)
library(raster)

EX1<-stack("C:/Users/dell/Downloads/EX6_RGB.jpg")
plotRGB(EX1, r = 1, g = 2, b = 3)

EX1.Crop <- fieldCrop(mosaic = EX1)
EX1.Rotated<-fieldRotate(mosaic = EX1.Crop, clockwise = F, h=F)
EX1.Rotated<-fieldRotate(mosaic = EX1.Crop, theta = 2.3)
source(system.file("extdata", "fieldRotate.R", package = "FIELDimageR")) # Available from FIELDimageR version 0.2.8
EX1.Rotated<-fieldRotate(mosaic = EX1.Crop, theta = 2.3, extentGIS=TRUE)

EX1.RemSoil<- fieldMask(mosaic = EX1.Rotated, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue = 3, index = "HUE")
EX1.Shape<-fieldShape(mosaic = EX1.RemSoil,ncols = 6, nrows = 12)

EX1.Indices<- fieldIndex(mosaic = EX1.RemSoil$newMosaic, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue = 3, 
                         index = c("NGRDI","BGI"), 
                         myIndex = c("(Red-Blue)/Green"))

# More than one myIndex code: myIndex = c("myIndex1","myIndex2","myIndex3")    

EX1.Indices.myIndex<- fieldIndex(mosaic = EX1.RemSoil$newMosaic, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue = 3, 
                                 index = c("NGRDI","BGI"), 
                                 myIndex = c("(Red-Blue)/Green","Red/Green","Blue/Green"))



EX1.Info<-fieldInfo(mosaic = EX1.Indices,fieldShape = EX1.Shape$fieldShape)
EX1.Info$fieldShape@data

fieldPlot(fieldShape = EX1.Info$fieldshape,fieldAttribute = "myIndex", mosaic = EX1.Indices, color = c("red","blue"), alpha = 0.5)

The Error Faced:

> EX1.Info<-fieldInfo(mosaic = EX1.Indices,fieldShape = EX1.Shape$fieldShape)
Error in if (projection(fieldShape) != projection(mosaic)) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
> EX1.Info$fieldShape@data
Error: object 'EX1.Info' not found

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Regarding Error faced in extracting the CSV data.
parts:
Hi there,

You can use projection=FALSE

EX1.Info<-fieldInfo(mosaic = EX1.Indices,fieldShape = EX1.Shape$fieldShape, projection=FALSE)

For more information about this function use this code on your R:

??FIELDimageR::fieldInfo

All the best,
Filipe
